headline: License Board to discuss Mikado Asian Cuisine alcohol license status and a new liquor license application for Amnol Market at 268-272 Rantoul Street.
summary: The board will review the status of the all-alcoholic beverages license from the former Mikado Asian Cuisine and hear from Deep Saini, LLC dba Amnol Market about a new Off-Premise Chapter 15 Green Grocery License. The board will also discuss a compliance check at JK Harrigan's dba Harrigan's Cork 'N Cask and review several one-day license applications.
items: Discuss status of all-alcoholic beverages license from former Mikado Asian Cuisine Restaurant, closed in 2025, and update on plans for the license, with Yan Xing Zheng

Review application for new Off-Premise Chapter 15 Green Grocery License for Deep Saini, LLC dba Amnol Market, Sukhwinder Singh Manager, for sale of alcoholic beverages at 268-272 Rantoul Street, Beverly
Discuss compliance check at JK Harrigan's dba Harrigan's Cork 'N Cask where alcohol was sold to an underage operative, with Gregory Saulnier Manager
Review one day license application from Trustees of Reservations-Long Hill for designated area for Halloween on the Hill
